title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers — Issue Grounds, Activation and Face Value Rules
content:
**Rule 1. Grounds of issue.** Each instrument of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers is issued only on the grounds listed for it below, and every instrument requires a source ticket.

| Instrument | Grounds of issue | Source ticket required |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Residual Travel Credit | exchange residual; credit redeposit | Yes |
| Crestline Flight Credit | voluntary cancellation; involuntary cancellation; credit redeposit | Yes |
| Crestline Trip Credit | refund alternative; credit redeposit | Yes |
| Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate | service recovery; credit redeposit | Yes |
| Crestline Disruption Voucher | irregular-operations goodwill; credit redeposit | Yes |
| Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher | denied boarding; credit redeposit | Yes |

**Rule 2. Activation.** An instrument becomes usable either automatically or on the passenger's acceptance. Where acceptance is needed, the passenger must accept the voucher within the acceptance window, counted in calendar days after issue; the window is 0 where acceptance is not needed.

**Rule 3. Face value.** A credit is not issued for less than the instrument's minimum face value, and its face value is rounded at issue either to the cent or to the whole dollar, whole-dollar rounding being half up.

**Rule 4. Refund-alternative bonus.** Where a customer entitled to a refund chooses the credit instead, a bonus of the stated percent of the refundable amount is added, the bonus being no larger than the stated cap.

| Instrument | Becomes usable | Acceptance window (calendar days) | Minimum face value (USD) | Face value rounded to | Refund-alternative bonus (percent) | Bonus cap (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Residual Travel Credit | automatically | 0 | 10.00 | cent | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Flight Credit | automatically | 0 | 0.01 | cent | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Trip Credit | automatically | 0 | 0.01 | cent | 10 | 100 |
| Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate | automatically | 0 | 25.00 | whole dollar | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Disruption Voucher | automatically | 0 | 25.00 | whole dollar | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher | on passenger acceptance | 14 | 25.00 | cent | 0 | 0 |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

- *Whole-dollar rounding.* A Crestline Disruption Voucher whose value works out at 37.50 US dollars is issued at 38; at 37.49 it is issued at 37. At 24.00 it is below the minimum face value of 25 and is not issued.
- *Cent rounding.* A Crestline Flight Credit whose value works out at 0.004 US dollars rounds to 0.00 and falls below the minimum face value of 0.01; at 0.01 it is issued.
- *Bonus cap.* On a refundable amount of 600 US dollars a Crestline Trip Credit bonus of 10 percent is 60; on 1,500 US dollars 10 percent would be 150, and the bonus is capped at 100.
